messages:
marta: Quick sync 99we need to finalize GA gates for the Optimize toolkit (batching, prefix caching, quant profiles, eval-triggered alerts). Customers pushing for end-of-Q3.

camille: Agree. Main concerns: regression risk from quant, alert noise, and clear rollout safety.

raj: Minimum pilot acceptance I propose: p99 under SLO for representative traces, <5% quality delta on guarded eval, and alert FP rate <10% over initial 2-week canary.

jen: Guarded eval must be explicit: 5k combined customer+edge prompts, labelled failure modes, and a small human review band during canary (10-20 samples/day).

marta: Draft acceptance checklist: perf targets (p50/p95/p99), quality delta <=3% on guarded eval, runtime fallback to FP32 on regression, eval-alerts wired to pager and digest, cost-delta estimates per route, devex toggles per-route.

camille: Add a preview UX: estimate quality delta for chosen quant profile before enabling canary. Reduces surprises.

raj: Canary rollout plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%, hold windows 24-48h, auto-rollback on SLO breach or eval-alert threshold.

simon: Ops needs batch size histograms surfaced and cost-delta calc in console. Also expose a per-route batching telemetry for pilot customers.

jen: Eval-alert tiers to avoid pager fatigue: "warning" -> slack digest + stored metrics; "critical" -> pager. Paging only after min_hits (e.g., 20) in a 1h window.

marta: Example eval-alert config for runbook: { eval_id: "cust-guard-2026-01", threshold: 0.85, window: "1h", min_hits: 20, action: "pager" }

raj: Also need an automatic fallback toggle: if low-confidence tokens or eval-alert breach, switch to higher-precision model transparently. Configurable per-route.

camille: Pilot cohort suggestion: Nimbly (high throughput), ClearScale (mid-market SLA), Platform Labs (internal multi-tenant test). I'll ping them.

marta: Timeline: engineering needs ~4w for rollout infra + 2w for eval infra. External pilot kickoff in 8-9 weeks sounds feasible.

Action items:
- camille: customer outreach + intake form (EOW)
- raj: canary + rollback automation + runbook (1w)
- jen: guarded eval set + scoring pipeline (10d)
- simon: console histograms + cost delta prototype (2w)

ops-bot: Created checklist: https://redwood.internal/deploy-checks/optimize-toolkit-pilot :white_check_mark:

marta: Reconvene next Tue to sign off cohort and checklist. Thanks :rocket:
